text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival. The Umamusume put on various 
events to entertain their fans, however...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
? Ticket? What brought this on all of a 
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaaahhhhh!! Hayahide, save meeeeee!!
choice_data_list: Looks like you're in a bit of a pinch...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm in a huge pinch here~! 
Hayahide, please, I need your help too~!

Winning Ticket panics in flustered 
confusion. Deciding to follow her for the 
time being—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now, a festival of intellect where trivia 
reigns supreme! Which one will be crowned 
the King of Racing Trivia—!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Biwa Hayahide. Were you roped into 
participating against your will as well?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... That is actually true.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. But it really helps that an 
Umamusume like you stepped forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An equipment malfunction hit the original 
event, so apparently they hastily decided 
to hold a quiz show to stall for time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. And Ticket had a hand in that, did 
she...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was only called in to entertain 
until the equipment is fixed. Nice and 
easy. Let's take it relaxed and dive right 
in.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez! Do your best--!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now for Question 1! "The turf courses of 
each racetrack, 3—"
(Ping!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Five. The racecourses with elevation 
changes of 3 meters or more are Nakayama, 
Kyoto, Chukyo, Kokura, and Hakodate.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C-Correct! The question was: "How many 
racetracks have a turf course with a slope 
of 3m or more?" —The correct answer is 5 
racetracks in total!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wah! Pre-zident, you're amaziiing!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now, now, Teio. You are part of the 
audience, so you should stay in the 
stands.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What... The President is going all 
out?! She isn't holding back in the 
slightest?!)

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf is so strong, as expected~~! 
Hayahide, hang in there~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I can't really back down here. Not 
when there are fans cheering me on—)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahideee! Do your best! I brought folks 
to cheer you on, too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I came to the plaza like you wanted. 
...Are we done now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Wh-Why is Brian here?!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No, no! We're here to cheer for Hayahide! 
Come on, all together now. Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide, do your best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's quite a loud voice... Hm? Is 
that Brian over there?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Now for Question 2! "The Tokyo Race—"
(Ping!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
525.9 meters. If the question is about 
Tokyo Racecourse's homestretch, that is.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Correct! 525 meters!! Hayahide fired 
back with an instant answer of her own!!
(WOOOO--!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, this time I truly hold a grudge 
against you, Ticket.

The heated Trivia King showdown. And the 
winner is—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
âPresident Rudolf takes the win, heck 
yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay!! As expected of the President!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're getting too carried away, 
Teio. Don't you have preparations for the 
next event too?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. If only I had gotten just 
one more question right...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

Biwa Hayahide let out a frustrated, 
slightly exhausted sigh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, this time I truly hold a grudge 
against you, Ticket.

The heated Trivia King showdown. And the 
winner is—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide takes the win, baby!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, I suppose I was able to 
deliver results worthy of everyone's 
support.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hayahide! Great job today~~!! And 
thank you sooo much for joining us~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Next time, you'd better 
explain what kind of crisis it is before 
dragging me along.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...So, umm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket, are you alone right now?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm. I see...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! But until just a little while ago, I 
was cheering with Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When Hayahide won, Brian smiled just a 
little bit!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, so that was it.
Biwa Hayahide wore a shy, bashful smile.
